scope: Bounded postwar institutional history 1945–2003 linking national-security architecture, conscience safeguards, domestic enforcement and immigration; no claim of linear causal destiny.
limitations: Search/open provides parsed platform excerpts, not raw upstream HTTP receipts.
next_step: Verify legislative implementation clauses and remaining 1980–2003 originals; write24-or-fewermilestones.
consequential_findings: Original 1947 law created national-security coordination but expressly separated CIA from police/internal-security authority; July26 enactment confirmed original, one official retrospective has July27 error.
EO9835 original includes employee hearing, counsel and administrative appeals; do not repeat no-appeal claim from secondary summary.
1955 military Code of Conduct contains God language, but combat/captivity scope distinct from general promotion loyalty test.
1971 repeal and 1972 Laird standing rule must be separate: Laird is not a merits endorsement of every surveillance practice.
